# neo4j-etl-lib

> Python building blocks to assemble ETL pipelines into Neo4j: batching, Pydantic validation, parallel loading, reporting.

## Start here

- [Building pipelines](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/concepts.html): how tasks, task groups and processor chains are meant to be combined. Read this first.
- [Batching and streaming](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/batching.html): how data flows from source to sink within one task.

## Reference

- [Data sources](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/data-sources.html): CSV, JSON, Parquet, Neo4j, SQL.
- [Data sinks](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/data-sinks.html)
- [Validation](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/validation.html): Pydantic row validation and error files.
- [Parallel processing](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/parallel.html): mix-and-batch relationship loading.
- [Testing](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/testing.html): test_utils fixtures and test databases.
- [API reference](https://neo-technology-field.github.io/python-etl-lib/source/etl_lib.html)

## Examples

- [gtfs](https://github.com/neo-technology-field/python-etl-lib/tree/main/examples/gtfs): complete CSV pipeline with a click CLI.
- [musicbrainz](https://github.com/neo-technology-field/python-etl-lib/tree/main/examples/musicbrainz): SQL source.
- [nyc-taxi](https://github.com/neo-technology-field/python-etl-lib/tree/main/examples/nyc-taxi): parallel loading.
